system.name: MambaLRP
system.one_liner: A Layer-wise Relevance Propagation method for Mamba models that restores relevance conservation at the components where basic LRP breaks it.

content.variant_note: panel a sets the starting point (LRP equals Gradient x Input), panel b shows basic LRP breaking conservation across two Mamba blocks with a noisy heatmap, panel c repeats the same blocks with repaired components, equal numbers and a focused heatmap
content.argues: Basic LRP breaks relevance conservation in some Mamba components and yields noisy explanations; reworking the propagation there restores conservation and gives faithful explanations.
content.subject: a small network with backward relevance, then two Mamba blocks under basic LRP and under MambaLRP with relevance numbers and dog-image heatmaps

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw the same blocks twice, before and after the method, and print the quantity that should be conserved at every boundary; equal against unequal numbers make the fix visible at a glance, and a photo and heatmap pair closes each lane.
lessons.suits: explainability or analysis methods where an invariant (conservation, sum, norm) is broken by some components and repaired by the proposed rule.

evidence: Conceptual steps involved in the design of MambaLRP.
Our analysis reveals three components in the Mamba architecture where conservation breaks
Rework the relevance propagation strategy at those layers to achieve conservation.

summary: MambaLRP extends Layer-wise Relevance Propagation to Mamba models by restoring relevance conservation where basic LRP breaks it. Figure 1 shows the three conceptual design steps in three panels. Panel a) sketches relevance flowing back through a small network, equal to Gradient x Input. Panel b) draws two Mamba blocks under basic LRP with relevance numbers that differ across each block, a red conservation break tag and a noisy dog heatmap. Panel c) draws the same blocks under the MambaLRP wordmark with green wrenches on the reworked components, equal numbers on both sides, a green conservation tag and a focused heatmap.
summary_zh: MambaLRP 让 LRP 在 Mamba 模型中保持相关性守恒。图分三格：a 为小网络与梯度×输入，b 为基础 LRP 的两个 Mamba 块，边界数值不等并给出嘈杂热图，c 为同样的块加绿色扳手修复，数值相等，热图聚焦。
notes: Prior kinds kept with concept-schematic added for panel a). The scale of the pink bars is not stated, and which printed number belongs to which border is read from the picture. The grey square inside the blocks is probably the selective SSM but is not labelled in the figure.
